items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-08-01
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] It's got Charlie Miller then, by then, huh? ... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah.

ctx.x: No. Now, this was the year before. That's the reason why you don't see us on here. I don't think. No. This picture was... This was the program that was issued that night. Shark Inn is Kings of Dixie. Mm-hmm.
It's got Leslie Chink. Oh, it's got Charlie Miller then, by then, huh? Mm-hmm. Yeah, Charlie Miller was... On Trombone. Yeah. And Mark.
